subject.title: fix: resolve Codex fork duplication when parent is unresolved (#2108)

question: After the two correctness defects and proof gap are resolved, should this PR or https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118 become the canonical cross-file fork implementation?
rationale: Both branches address overlapping fork identity and cache-dependency invariants with different mechanisms, and choosing or combining those contracts requires ownership of the long-term scanner design rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Repair then consolidate
options.body: Fix this PR's two defects, compare both branches against the same frozen corpus, and combine only the compatible identity and cache-dependency behavior into one landing branch.

options.title: Adopt the proven alternative
options.body: Use https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118 as the canonical branch if its parent-fingerprint approach covers the unresolved-parent sibling case after focused comparison.

options.title: Keep this approach
options.body: Land this PR only after current-head real-corpus proof and close the competing branch once maintainers confirm its unique identity behavior is unnecessary.

recommendation.body: Fix this PR's two defects, compare both branches against the same frozen corpus, and combine only the compatible identity and cache-dependency behavior into one landing branch.
